subject.title: Suppress failed tool progress in Discord

question: Should this Discord message-delivery change wait for retained live proof, or can maintainers accept the source-level tests plus unretained canary observation?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the PR changes visible Discord delivery and the after-fix evidence is operator-observed without a retained transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs.

options.title: Wait for retained Discord proof
options.body: Require a redacted Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs proving failed draft progress is hidden and fallback warnings still deliver before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally land after branch refresh based on the focused diff, tests, screenshot of the pre-fix leak, and operator-observed canary result.

options.title: Pause until proof is practical
options.body: Keep the PR open but blocked if neither the contributor nor a maintainer can capture the Discord path yet.

recommendation.title: Wait for retained Discord proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted Discord transcript, recording, terminal output, or logs proving failed draft progress is hidden and fallback warnings still deliver before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Discord and shared channel-progress history makes this the best available routing candidate for the proof and message-delivery judgment.
